definitions.explanation: Someone who has been part of an organization or group for a long time.
A fan who has been following an artist, content creator, or franchise since early on. Common in online communities.

examples.japanese: {古参|こさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会|かい}→会：27493_kai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめている→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: The senior members organize the group.

examples.japanese: {古参|こさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{兵士|へいし}→兵士：11680_heishi⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦{兵|へい}→兵：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{指導|しどう}→指導：03190_shidou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

notes:
REGISTER: Originally formal/literary, now also casual in online contexts.

ORIGINAL MEANING:
{古参|こさん} originally referred to senior members of an organization, particularly those with long service in a company or military unit.

MODERN FAN CULTURE USAGE:
In online and fan communities, {古参|こさん} specifically means someone who has been a fan since the early days:
- {古参|こさん}⟦ファン→ファン：10065_fan⟧: longtime fan
- {古参|こさん}⟦リスナー→リスナー：29511_risunaa⟧: longtime listener/viewer
- {古参|こさん}⟦{勢|ぜい}→勢：noentry⟧: the veteran fan group

CONTRAST WITH ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧:
- {古参|こさん}: longtime fan (since early days)
- ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧: new fan (recently joined)

NOTE: In fan communities, there can sometimes be tension between {古参|こさん} and ⟦{新規|しんき}→新規：06289_shinki⟧, with some {古参|こさん} acting superior or gatekeeping. The term {古参|こさん}⟦アピール→アピール：10701_apiiru⟧ (showing off veteran status) is often used critically.
